task: Epic 24 user stories: approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Seven stories cover the planned code and test work and trace to BRD-024, FDD-024, and accepted ADR-024.
Acceptance criteria are concrete contract-test assertions with defined fixtures, expected outputs, errors, and boundaries.
Stories distinguish implementation from out-of-scope work and identify approval, scope, Appendix A, and seed-profile dependencies without implying authorization.
Story statuses and criteria preserve human ownership of profiles and decisions and do not claim empirical recommendation effectiveness.

evidence.source: direct_doc_read:Epic 24 comprises seven stories for profile, rules, filtering, ranking, decision, seed table, and seed cases, traceable to FDD-024 and BRD-024
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 criteria give concrete fixture catalogs/profiles, expected values, validation failures, persistence checks, and synthetic evidence labels
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 states no story dependency on another Epic, marks approval/D5/D10 dependencies, and blocks implementation pending scope authorization
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 requires human-declared profiles and decisions, names the pending human seed declarations, and disclaims effectiveness claims
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 names source ADR, BRD, and FDD and enumerates seven stories
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 provides fixtures and measurable acceptance criteria
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 states implementation is blocked pending baseline authorization
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 separates human decisions from automated recommendation
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 maps all seven work areas to FDD-024 contracts
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 acceptance criteria are measurable; Appendix A and profile decisions remain explicit prerequisites
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 clearly separates approval, catalog updates, seed declarations, and PMP scope authorization
direct_doc_read:Epic 24 labels draft status and pending human-owned decisions accurately
